The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's at step 17. The dojos.info listing it had just received showed every school at 1.46 to 1.79 miles from the search point, far beyond a five-minute walk from the NYSE. The Orchestrator still recorded the list as progress and sent WebSurfer to keep clicking through individual listings, instead of rejecting the results and running a new search for schools near Wall Street. The failed run then ended with two non-qualifying schools, and the correct answer, Renzo Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Wall Street, was never found.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 17
